field_updates.detail: p1 'Permissible film temperature, ϑF max. 155 °C'; p1 'The rated dissipation applies only if the permitted film temperature is not exceeded'; P70 (standard) for CRCW1206 = 0.25 W (p1); p6 Derating figure: CRCW1206 line flat at 0.25 W to 70 °C, reaching 0 W at 155 °C (visually read). Method: Rth = (155 - 70) K / 0.25 W = 340.0 K/W. Linear derating means film/element temperature = T_amb + Rth*P reaches the endpoint on the derating line, so Rth_implied = (T_end - T_knee)/P_rated. This is the derating-implied thermal resistance on the manufacturer's (unstated) reference mounting, not a measured or board-specific value.
